newsitem.title: USA: Spartech says six mln shares offered.
newsitem.headline: Spartech says six mln shares offered.

text.p: Spartech Corp said Wednesday it is offering six million shares of common stock at 9.25 per share.
Of the total, three million shares are being sold by the company and three million by certain selling shareholders.
CFS First Boston and A.G. Edwards & Sons Inc are managing the underwriting syndicate offering the shares.

Spartech said it will use proceeds it receives, together with additional debt financing for the previously announced acquisition of the Hamelin Group. Spartech produces thermoplastic materials and polymeric compounds.
